_comment: Spoken by each boss at the start of its fight and after it falls. Read by main.gd via EventBus.boss_encounter_started / boss_defeated.

goblin_king.name: Skarn the Crowned
goblin_king.intro: You brought a sword to a court.
goblin_king.defeat: The crown rolls. Nobody picks it up.
phases: The crown is a loan, and the court is a rumour. Neither of them can be killed, boy.
Good! Now the ledger is even. Whoever walks out of this room keeps the chair.

slag_wraith.name: The Slag Wraith
slag_wraith.intro: Heat without a body. It says your name in furnace-tongue.
slag_wraith.defeat: It cools into a shape like a person, and then into slag.
phases: You are cooling me. I do not remember agreeing to be cooled.
Every ladder in this works was built by a man who promised he would be out by dark.

bone_titan.name: The Bone Titan
bone_titan.intro: It stands up out of the crypt floor, still counting.
bone_titan.defeat: Ten thousand ribs come apart and stay apart.
phases: One more. That is all I was ever asked for: one more, and then the count is done.
The shelves are full of people who counted better than you.

frost_giant.name: Hrim, the Rimevault's Keeper
frost_giant.intro: Warm blood on my floor. In this vault that is a debt.
frost_giant.defeat: The vault keeps its cold, and you keep your life.
phases: Debt accrues. In this vault it accrues faster than anywhere warm.
I kept this door for eleven hundred winters. I will be allowed to dislike you.

choir_priest.name: Cantor Vail
choir_priest.intro: Sing with us, vessel. The Choir is only ever short one voice.
choir_priest.defeat: The hymn stops mid-word. The silence after is enormous.
phases: The harmony does not want your sword, vessel. It wants your breath, and it will take the second.
Listen: the whole valley is a throat, and I am only the part that says the words.

ember_warden.name: The Ember Warden
ember_warden.intro: I kept the fire so it would not spread. You kept walking toward it.
ember_warden.defeat: The Warden lets go, and the fire it held goes with it.
phases: I was put here to guard. Do not mistake my patience for a cage.
Then we will find out whether you can carry what you came up here to take.
